decision: Requisitions of equipment packages with 30 weeks or more manufacture, of the packages whose certified data governs early civil works (shop-built tanks MR-ME-013, HRSG blowdown and drain tanks MR-ME-019), of the large-diameter GRP CW pipes (MR-PI-004) and of the early civil / marine subcontracts are issued at NTP from the tender-stage specifications and datasheets; construction power (MR-EL-011) is ordered at NTP + 2 weeks with rental generators until the RMU is energised.
rationale: With the Rev B MDL and a 12-week engineering mobilisation, these requisitions cannot be prepared after NTP without delaying deliveries beyond the CWP need dates (PWP float -16 to -43 wd).
title: Long-lead requisitions issued from the tender-stage specifications at NTP
